ideas.title: Following the Money Trail in Childcare Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and money laundering schemes involved in childcare program fraud
questions: How are fraudulent childcare programs laundering money?
What are the financial links between ghost companies and legitimate businesses?
ideas.insight: By analyzing financial transactions and identifying patterns of money laundering, we may be able to uncover the extent of the fraud scheme and identify key players.
